name: @enlitt/unity-signin
description: Unity sign-in kit (UPM com.enlitt.signin). A pnpm wrapper so the repo's checks reach the dotnet tests; the UPM package itself is upm/.

scripts.lint: sh ../../tools/dotnet.sh format tests/Enlitt.SignIn.Tests --verify-no-changes && sh ../../tools/dotnet.sh format tests/UnityCompileCheck --verify-no-changes
scripts.typecheck: sh ../../tools/dotnet.sh build -warnaserror tests/Enlitt.SignIn.Tests && sh ../../tools/dotnet.sh build -warnaserror tests/UnityCompileCheck
